question: Who among the following is the first Indian to win the under 10 World Chess Championship in Menorca, Spain in the year 1996?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P Harikrishna.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **P Harikrishna **is the** first Indian** to win the** under 10 World Chess Championship **in Menorca, Spain in the year **1996.**
 
• He is a renowned Indian chess player who has won** several national and international** chess championships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Koneru Humpy** is an **Indian chess grandmaster** who has **won three Women's World Chess Championships** and several other national and international titles. 
 
• **Vishwanathan Anand** is an** Indian chess grandmaster** and** former world chess champion** who has won several national and international chess championships.
 
• **Vidit Santosh Gujrathi **is an** Indian chess grandmaster** who has won several national and international chess championships.
